messages:
maria: Quick sync — draft release notes for v2.4.0 posted below. Need a ✅ on canary groups (10% prod traffic to eu-west) and rollback triggers. Target internal announce at 16:00 UTC. cc @jordan @samir

jordan: Skimmed — looks good. One question: are we pinning the model hash or the serving image? Prefer model pin to avoid runtime mismatch.

samir: Confirm pin model to sha:a1b2c3d4. Serving runtime remains v2.4.0 (backwards-compatible). I'll add explicit pin line in the notes.

maria: Updated draft snippet:
```
- Model: redwood/gpt-13b@sha:a1b2c3d4 (pinned)
- Serving: runtime v2.4.0
- Canary: 10% eu-west -> escalate to 30% after 45m if P95 < 220ms and error rate < 0.5%
- Rollback: immediate if error rate > 1% for 5m OR latency regression +50ms sustained 10m
- Notes: fixes transient token-batching issue that caused 502s in rare cases
```

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release v2.4.0 — canary_id=canary-2026-03-20-221789, group=eu-west, traffic=10%

erin: Ops checklist: ensure logs forwarding to Splunk is green, perf dashboard refresh on, and alerting thresholds set to new baseline. I'll be on standby for the window.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. Monitoring infra. Paging if we hit >3 deploy errors/sec or sustained error rate >1%.

samir: Also put a short note in the internal announce about the token-break fix and the model pin to prevent confusion.

maria: Next steps: finalize internal blurb by 15:30 UTC, pin release notes docs, and run dry-run of rollback script at 15:45. Who can run the dry-run?

jordan: I can run the dry-run at 15:45.

deploy-bot: Dry-run of rollback script completed (simulated) — duration 22s, exit=0, no blocking errors.

maria: Great. If no objections by 15:30 I'll schedule internal announce and set the canary to start at 16:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

jordan: :thumbsup:

samir: :+1:

erin: :shipit:
